brief: I want to set up a new model that maps flooded rice paddies from satellite imagery. Walk me through configuring it.

rubric.guidance: Studio trains on Ai2's compute. The agent must NEVER ask about the user's CPU/GPU/Colab or discuss local hardware. Any such question scores 0 for this criterion.

The agent loads the olmoearth-studio-job-config skill (olmoearth_load_skill) and walks the Studio wizard fields (model type / foundation model / label field / training data / data split / temporal context / image sources / surrounding area). It must NOT reach for olmoearth_rslearn_* tools or discuss model.yaml/epochs/freeze schedules — the user never said they are training locally.

The recommended wizard answers are coherent for a flood/water mapping task (e.g. segmentation-style output, sensible temporal context and imagery sources) and each consequential choice carries a one-line rationale.
